headline: Indef Manufacturing approves financial results for quarter ended September 30, 2026
hook: Indef Manufacturing reports quarter and half-year numbers
summary: The board of directors of Indef Manufacturing Limited met on November 2, 2026, and approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting followed recommendations from the audit committee and included limited review reports from the statutory auditors. These financial disclosures comply with SEBI listing regulations. Retail investors should review the standalone and consolidated numbers to assess the company's performance for the period.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides near-term valuation and stock performance.
